title: Text: DET Tom Moore ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Hi Anthony. Here is Oliver Arias’ contact info - 809.958.9322. oliver.arias@tigers.com. He’s in whatsapp as well. He will be available both Monday and Tuesday to take you to the academy. Right now he’s tied up on Sunday. I believe that there may be a shuttle at the Hampton Inn for airport pickups and drop offs. It would be worth looking into. As far as other players, SS Manuel Sequera (VZ) and OF Abelaldo López (DR) are two higher profile signings from Campos’ class. I would pay attention to CF José De La Cruz (DR), SS Adinso Reyes (DR) and OF Lázaro Benítez (CUB) that are here in Lakeland already and played in the DSL last year. They are  all from the 2018-19 signing class (De La Cruz and Reyes are both 18 yrs old). Also, players that performed well in the DSL that will be in the academy include SS Cesar Calderon (DR), OF Iverson Leonardo (DR), IF/OF Carlos Mendoza (VZ). Some of our better arms are RHP Wilmer Fenelon (DR) - the 19 yr old (we have 2 with the same name), RHP Erick Pinales (DR) and Adolfo Bauza (VZ). Rafael Martinez (Dir. Latín American Player Development) will be at the academy as well and will be a good resource to speak with. If you have any other questions or need any info, please let me know.
Thank you, Tom. Appreciate this. Safe travels, see you next week
